name: Bryn Haworth
description:
'''Bryn Haworth''' (born 29 July 1948) is a British [[contemporary Christian music|Christian]] singer-songwriter, guitarist, and pioneer of [[Jesus music]] in mainstream [[Rock music|rock]]. Born in [[Blackburn]], [[Lancashire]], England, he has released some twenty-two albums and several singles since the 1970s, as well as guesting as guitarist on many other albums by rock and [[Folk music|folk]] artists. He continues to tour in the UK, appearing mostly at smaller venues, Christian centres and at prisons. He has also appeared three times at the UK [[Greenbelt Festival]]. His chosen instruments include guitar (particularly [[slide guitar|slide]] or [[bottleneck guitar]]) and [[mandolin]].

In the mid-1970s he recorded sessions for the [[John Peel]] show on [[BBC Radio 1]] and made two television appearances on [[BBC Two]]'s ''[[The Old Grey Whistle Test]]''. More recently, with wife Sally, Haworth has engaged in extensive musical and [[evangelical]] work in prison settings.
